pilot_operation_receipt_check.name: pilot_operation_receipt_check
pilot_operation_receipt_check.value: ("app"."pilot_operation"."state" = 'completed') = ("app"."pilot_operation"."receipt_id" is not null and "app"."pilot_operation"."receipt_recorded_at" is not null and "app"."pilot_operation"."receipt_job_id" is not null)

operation_receipt_kind_check.name: operation_receipt_kind_check
operation_receipt_kind_check.value:
("fixture_inventory"."operation_receipt"."kind" = 'reserve' and "fixture_inventory"."operation_receipt"."successor_version" is not null
            and "fixture_inventory"."operation_receipt"."transfer_request_id" is null and "fixture_inventory"."operation_receipt"."request_version" is null)
       or ("fixture_inventory"."operation_receipt"."kind" = 'create_transfer_request' and "fixture_inventory"."operation_receipt"."successor_version" is null
            and "fixture_inventory"."operation_receipt"."transfer_request_id" is not null and "fixture_inventory"."operation_receipt"."request_version" is not null)
